text:
kate: Quick ask 10am PT next Thursday web4re doing a small studio-style webinar (90m). Need: final reg page, Zoom layout for panel+Q&A, studio recording approach, captions, and the post-event lead handoff flow. Can we finalize by Tue COB?

liam: Agree callout 'studio session' and 'limited seats' on the page. Suggest a single registration that shows three local times (PT/ET/CET) and picks one canonical timezone in HubSpot.

jin: I can do reg page copy + form mapping. Plan to include a consent checkbox: "We may record and reuse this session for marketing purposes". Hidden fields: utm_source=launch_series, campaign=studio_webinar_04, session=studio-04. Also include a required company size dropdown for lead scoring.

leo: Recording options: prefer a clean master recorded via a dedicated recorder VM (OBS) capturing gallery+slides as a single feed. Enable cloud recording as fallback. For captions, enable Zoom live transcription but also run a post-process VTT via Google Speech or AssemblyAI for accuracy.

maya: I can spin up an OBS machine in GCP and be co-host/recorder. We'll pull the presenter's gallery and slide share into a 1080p canvas, record locally to the VM, and upload to S3 after the event. Also test scene transitions and lower-thirds for speaker names.

kate: Good. Deliverables: 1) gated replay for registrants, 2) six promo clips (30-90s), 3) full transcript + VTT, 4) HubSpot segmentation: registered, attended, watched_replay.

liam: Post-event pipeline recommended: Zoom cloud webhook -> Lambda (validate webhook) -> move files to S3 -> trigger transcript job -> notify production team Slack channel. For clips: we can use a tiny Python tool that reads a JSON with timestamps and produces ffmpeg jobs.

jin: HubSpot details: use one form on the page that writes to contact properties: hb_campaign, session_id, registration_time. For gating replay, generate a signed URL with expiry and require email match via a small lookup microservice.

leo: Example webhook consumer snippet (curl-style example for Zoom recording_ready webhook):

curl -X POST \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  -d '{"meeting_id":"<id>","recording_files":[{"download_url":"<url>"}]}' \ 
  https://our-ingest.example.com/zoom/webhook

leo: Example ffmpeg trimming command web4ll use in the python tool (different from our old scripts):

ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -ss 00:12:30 -to 00:13:15 -i master.mp4 -vf "scale=1080:1080,subtitles=transcript.vtt:force_style='Fontsize=24'" -c:v libx264 -crf 23 -c:a aac clip_1.mp4

maya: Ops checklist (compact):
- jin: publish reg page + HubSpot form, include hidden fields (by Tue noon)
- leo: confirm OBS VM + upload flow to S3 (test Wed)
- liam: add webhook lambda and Slack notifier (test Wed)
- kate: finalize speaker names + lower-thirds (Wed COB)
- maya: dry-run recording + caption pipeline 24h before

liam: For analytics: add UTM params on all promo links, track page view -> form submit -> attendance. Also emit events for 'replay_requested' and 'clip_view'.

kate: Owners recap: jin (reg page + gating), maya (recording + OBS scenes), leo (ingest + transcripts), liam (automation + analytics), kate (program lead & speaker ops). I'll send a calendar invite for a final preflight on Wed 11am PT.

jin: Confirmed I'll put draft copy in #marketing-assets and assign the HubSpot form to leo for testing.

maya: Confirmed. I'll provision VM and share the OBS scene collection before the dry-run.

webhookbot: Zoom webhook subscription created for meeting studio-04 (webhook_id=wb_44321).

kate: Thanks team If no blockers web4re locked. I'll ping if vendor caption costs change.
